services.desc: At United Studios of Self Defense, every student receives thirty minutes of private or semi-private instruction each week. Personal Instruction provides the ultimate in personal training. This focused learning approach insures that each student will get the attention they need to succeed. Each class is tailored to the needs of the student, which allows progress at a much faster rate. Students can receive additional help in troubled areas. That’s why we’re proud to partner with charter schools throughout Orange County California to bring the transformative power of karate to their diverse student body. Charter schools, with their emphasis on innovation and individualized learning, are a perfect fit for our unique approach to karate instruction.
